# pkg_regex: # majors = installed SDK majors the entry applies to. kind: removed | renamed | inert | deprecated | changed-default | platform-gated. when: optional unit predicate (platform:macos, role:library ...).

name: enableSpotlight
message: Removed in 6.0; use the spotlight option instead (spotlight: true, or a sidecar URL string).

name: spotlightSidecarUrl
message: Removed in 6.0; pass the sidecar URL as a string to the spotlight option instead.

name: beforeNavigate
message: Removed in 6.0; use beforeStartSpan on Sentry.reactNativeTracingIntegration(), which can change span options but cannot cancel the span.

name: idleTimeout
message: Removed in 6.0 from React Native tracing; use idleTimeoutMs on Sentry.reactNativeTracingIntegration().

name: maxTransactionDuration
message: Removed in 6.0 from React Native tracing; use finalTimeoutMs on Sentry.reactNativeTracingIntegration().

name: RoutingInstrumentation
message: Removed in 6.0; for custom navigation call Sentry.startIdleNavigationSpan() on each route change instead.

name: ReactNativeTracing
message: Replaced in 6.0 by Sentry.reactNativeTracingIntegration(); options such as enableAppStartTracking moved to Sentry.init.

name: ReactNavigationInstrumentation
message: Replaced in 6.0 by Sentry.reactNavigationIntegration() in the Sentry.init integrations array.

name: ReactNativeNavigationInstrumentation
message: Replaced in 6.0 by Sentry.reactNativeNavigationIntegration({ navigation }) in the integrations array.

name: autoSessionTracking
message: Removed as an option in 7.0; use enableAutoSessionTracking, which is enabled by default.

name: enableTracing
message: Removed in 7.0; set tracesSampleRate above 0 to enable tracing (0 keeps the integrations active without sampling).

name: getCurrentHub
message: Removed in 7.0 along with the Hub API; the changelog names no replacement, so drop the call and use the current scope and client APIs.

name: sendDefaultPii
message: Removed in 8.0; use dataCollection, since an unset value now infers IP addresses by default, so set dataCollection explicitly.

name: inboundFiltersIntegration
message: Renamed in 8.0 to eventFiltersIntegration (the integration name is now EventFilters).

name: skipOpenTelemetrySetup
message: Replaced in 8.0 by enableOpenTelemetrySetup, which defaults to false, so OpenTelemetry setup is now opt-in.

name: beforeSendTransaction
message: Inert in 8.0 because span streaming is the default and no transactions are sent; use beforeSendSpan, or set traceLifecycle to 'static' to keep transactions.

name: ignoreTransactions
message: Inert in 8.0 for the same reason; use ignoreSpans, or set traceLifecycle to 'static' to keep transactions.
